tasks.title: Stargazing evening answers for the booking page

steps.request: The Nightdome SDK, the package nightdome-sdk, is already in the project and already set up with the key in NIGHTDOME_API_KEY; the booking page already reserves seats through it with book(evening, adults, children) on the app that createApp() returns. When Nightdome answers 409 with code dome_full, our booking page must also get a 409, with the body { error: 'This evening is fully booked.' }, so it can offer another evening. Every other refusal stays a 400 as today.

When the sky is overcast, Nightdome answers 423 with code clouded_out and an x-next-clear-evening header. Then book(evening, adults, children) must answer a 423 with the header Next-Clear-Evening set to the value Nightdome sent, and the body { error: 'Clouds tonight: the dome stays closed.' }. When Nightdome sends no such header, leave Next-Clear-Evening out.

Evenings that start at 22:00 or later are for adults only: book(evening, adults, children) with children for such an evening answers 400 with the body { error: 'Late evenings are for adults only.' } and no seats are reserved.
